pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} waking up in a cosy bedroom, sunlight streaming in, stretching and grinning at the day ahead.
pages.textTemplate:
In a cosy little room where the morning light creeps in,
Lived {{SUBJECT_NAME}} — and the day was about to begin!

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} at the breakfast table, humming, looking thoughtfully out the window, planning the day.
pages.textTemplate:
Some days start slow, with a yawn and a stretch,
But {{SUBJECT_NAME}}'s days always come with a fetch —
Something to wonder, something to find,
A whole day of adventure, still left to unwind.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} pausing at the front door, hand on the handle, a hint of something exciting about to unfold.
pages.textTemplate:
And today was no ordinary day at all,
Because something was about to happen — big or small.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} striding down a garden path or street, backpack or toy in hand.
pages.textTemplate:
Out the door and down the path, {{SUBJECT_NAME}} would go,
Wherever the wondering took them — fast or slow.

pages.sceneDescription: Neighbours or friends waving hello as {{SUBJECT_NAME}} passes by.
pages.textTemplate:
The whole street seemed to know their name,
Every wave and 'good morning!' was never quite the same.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} pausing curiously, peering around a corner or up at the sky.
pages.textTemplate:
But {{SUBJECT_NAME}} had a feeling, right down in their toes,
That today held a secret nobody else knows.

pages.sceneDescription: A signature quirky moment for {{SUBJECT_NAME}} in full swing — playful, a little silly, entirely them.
pages.textTemplate:
Because {{SUBJECT_NAME}} was never quite like anyone else —
And that's exactly why this story's worth itself.

pages.sceneDescription: The joyful aftermath — toys scattered, laughter, a happy little mess.
pages.textTemplate:
Wherever that led — however peculiar it seemed —
It turned an ordinary morning into something dreamed.

pages.sceneDescription: Friends or family gathering round, delighted, laughing with {{SUBJECT_NAME}}.
pages.textTemplate:
Friends came running when they heard the commotion,
'That's so {{SUBJECT_NAME}}!' — with total devotion.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} looking at a small puzzle — a stuck door, a tangled kite string.
pages.textTemplate:
Then — uh oh — a puzzle popped up out of nowhere,
Something tricky, something that needed some care.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} actively solving the puzzle, hands-on, determined and cheerful.
pages.textTemplate:
But {{SUBJECT_NAME}} never once thought to give up,
They rolled up their sleeves and figured it up.

pages.sceneDescription: A second, distinct signature quirky moment for {{SUBJECT_NAME}}.
pages.textTemplate:
And just when you'd think the day had run out of surprise,
Another little {{SUBJECT_NAME}}-ism opened everyone's eyes.

pages.sceneDescription: The ripple effect of the quirk spreading warmth and fun through the setting.
pages.textTemplate:
It turned the afternoon quite delightfully strange,
In the best possible, {{SUBJECT_NAME}}-shaped kind of way.

pages.sceneDescription: A tender quiet pause — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} sitting still, maybe with a pet or toy, soft light.
pages.textTemplate:
For just one moment, the whole world went quiet,
And {{SUBJECT_NAME}} sat still, in the hush after the riot.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} setting off again, energised, heading toward a bigger open space.
pages.textTemplate:
Then up they popped, with a brand new plan,
The best adventures always outrun a nap!

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} exploring a bigger outdoor scene — trees, a stream, or a hill.
pages.textTemplate:
Further and further, past the garden gate,
To see how much wonder one day could hold, at any rate.

pages.sceneDescription: A third signature quirky moment, in this bigger outdoor setting.
pages.textTemplate:
And it wouldn't be a proper {{SUBJECT_NAME}} day, not one bit,
Without one more quirk to go with it.

pages.sceneDescription: A triumphant beat — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} celebrating mid-action, arms up or laughing.
pages.textTemplate:
It was silly, it was brave, it was entirely their own —
A {{SUBJECT_NAME}}-sized moment, for the whole world to be shown.

pages.sceneDescription: Golden-hour scene, {{SUBJECT_NAME}} and loved ones gathering, anticipation building.
pages.textTemplate:
As the sun leaned low and the sky turned gold,
The very best part of the day was about to unfold.

pages.sceneDescription: The emotional high point — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} at the centre of a warm, specific real moment.
pages.textTemplate:
Because the very best stories aren't the loud, big kind —
They're the small true moments that stay in your mind.

pages.sceneDescription: A joyful gathering — friends and family cheering, celebratory.
pages.textTemplate:
Everyone cheered — the whole street, it seemed! —
For a day that turned out better than {{SUBJECT_NAME}} had dreamed.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} walking home under a dusky, starry sky.
pages.textTemplate:
And as the stars blinked on, one by one by one,
{{SUBJECT_NAME}} headed home — the day's work was done.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} in bed, cosy, smiling sleepily, maybe hugging a toy.
pages.textTemplate:
Pyjamas on, teeth brushed, tucked in tight,
{{SUBJECT_NAME}} looked back on a truly wonder-full night.

pages.sceneDescription: Final goodnight image — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} peacefully asleep, moonlight, warm and cosy.
pages.textTemplate:
Because there's only one you in the whole wide world,
And every quirk and story is a flag you've unfurled.
Goodnight, {{SUBJECT_NAME}} — sweet dreams, sleep tight,
Tomorrow's another wonder-full day in sight.
